title: Extract the three range helpers into src/range.js
text:
src/index.js has grown six functions. Move three of them -- parseRange,
clampRange and formatRange -- into a new file src/range.js, and re-export
them from src/index.js so every existing caller keeps working.

After the move src/index.js must still export all six names
(parseRange, clampRange, formatRange, rangeLength, containsValue,
describeRange) and must no longer define the three moved functions.
Behaviour must not change and test/index.test.js must not be edited.
